description: Bitrise lets users set up and manage mobile CI/CD from ChatGPT: register apps, trigger and inspect builds and pipelines, read build logs and artifacts, edit and validate bitrise.yml configuration, manage workspace members and groups, distribute builds to testers with Release Management, ship CodePush updates, and query build and test insights. Every tool acts on the authenticated user's own Bitrise account.
